dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Mingxing Jewelry Ad
dialogues.text: Come be enamored by our bright jade shining with the vibrance of the moon, and our dazzling gold flickering with the shine of the stars.

dialogues.speaker: Mingxing Jewelry Ad
dialogues.text: At this time we will only be accepting purchases by reservation for jewelry and large gemstone wares. We apologize for any inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, do you have any pairs of the Glazed Belt Hook in stock?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Sorry, we are currently out of stock. We can reserve a pair for you that we will make once our ore and gem inventory is replenished."
